messages.subject: For Mike Hsu | Sustainability, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Kimberly-Clark Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Mike Hsu, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Kimberly-Clark's global consumer portfolio requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability priorities and operating teams. That interface closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Kimberly-Clark's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kimberly-Clark.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
